papers.title: The Distribution of Envy in Matching Markets
papers.abstract: We study the distribution of envy in random matching markets under the Deferred Acceptance (DA) algorithm. Using tools from applied probability, we compute the expected number of proposing agents whom nobody envies and those who envy nobody. We obtain an exact finite-market expression for the former, based on a connection with the coupon collector problem, and asymptotic bounds for the latter. To put these quantities into perspective, we compare them to their counterparts under Random Serial Dictatorship (RSD): while RSD assigns a constant fraction of agents to their top choice, both DA and RSD leave exactly $H_n$ proposing agents unenvied in expectation. Our results show that these clearly unimprovable proposing agents constitute a vanishing fraction of the market.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在延迟接受（Deferred Acceptance, DA）算法下，随机匹配市场中嫉妒情绪的分布情况。利用应用概率学的工具，我们计算了那些不会引起他人嫉妒的提议者数量以及那些不会嫉妒任何人的提议者数量。对于前者，我们基于与“优惠券收集者问题”（coupon collector problem）的关联，得到了一个精确的有限市场表达式；而对于后者，则得出了渐近界限。为了将这些数量放在适当的视角下进行比较，我们将其与随机序列独裁（Random Serial Dictatorship, RSD）机制下的情况进行了对比：虽然RSD会将一定比例的代理人分配给他们最心仪的对象，但无论是DA还是RSD，都使得期望中有恰好$H_n$个提议者不会受到他人的嫉妒。我们的研究结果表明，这些显然无法被改善的提议者在整个市场中所占的比例微乎其微。。

papers.title: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment
papers.abstract: We introduce a new agentic artificial intelligence (AI) platform for portfolio management. Our architecture consists of three layers. First, two large language model (LLM) agents are assigned specialized tasks: one agent screens for firms with desirable fundamentals, while a sentiment analysis agent screens for firms with desirable news. Second, these agents deliberate to generate and agree upon buy and sell signals from a large portfolio, substantially narrowing the pool of candidate assets. Finally, we apply a high-dimensional precision matrix estimation procedure to determine optimal portfolio weights. A defining theoretical feature of our framework is that the number of assets in the portfolio is itself a random variable, realized through the screening process. We introduce the concept of sensible screening and establish that, under mild screening errors, the squared Sharpe ratio of the screened portfolio consistently estimates its target. Empirically, our method achieves superior Sharpe ratios relative to an unscreened baseline portfolio and to conventional screening approaches, evaluated on S&P 500 data over the period 2020--2024.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种用于投资组合管理的新型人工智能（AI）平台。该平台的架构包含三个层次：首先，两个大型语言模型（LLM）代理被分配了特定的任务——其中一个代理负责筛选具有理想基本面的公司，另一个代理则负责筛选具有有利新闻的公司；其次，这两个代理协同工作，从庞大的投资组合中生成并确定买入和卖出信号，从而大幅缩小候选资产的范围；最后，我们采用高维精度矩阵估计方法来确定最优的投资组合权重。我们框架的一个核心理论特点是：投资组合中的资产数量本身是一个随机变量，这一随机性是通过筛选过程实现的。我们提出了“合理筛选”（sensible screening）的概念，并证明在筛选误差较小的情况下，筛选后的投资组合的夏普比率（Sharpe ratio）能够持续准确地反映其目标表现。实证研究表明，与未经过筛选的投资组合以及传统的筛选方法相比，我们的方法在2020至2024年期间对标准普尔500指数（S&P 500）数据的分析中实现了更优的夏普比率。。

papers.title: Profitability of Participation Banks and Sectoral Economic Growth: An Analysis on Türkiye
papers.venue: International Journal of Islamic Economics and Finance Studies
papers.abstract: In economies with a bank-based financial system, banks are the primary institutions that perform the savings function of the financial system. For this reason, the profitability of banks is an important indicator of soundness in an effectively functioning financial system. In this context, the relationship between bank profitability and economic growth is also important for the real sector. This study aims to empirically demonstrate the causal relationship between the profitability of participation banks in Türkiye and sectoral economic growth. To this end, quarterly data from the period 2005Q1-2024Q3 were used to test the relationship between the profitability of assets and equity capital of participation banks and the growth of GDP, agriculture, industry, services and construction sectors using the Fourier Toda-Yamamoto Causality Test. According to the findings obtained from the analysis, a statistically significant and bidirectional causal relationship has been found between the profitability of participation banks in Türkiye and GDP and industrial sector growth; and between equity profitability and growth in the agriculture, industry and construction sectors. This situation has also demonstrated that the funds provided by participation banks operating in the Turkish banking sector have a positive impact on the industrial sector, both in terms of profitability and sector growth.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】在以银行为基础的金融体系中，银行是承担金融体系储蓄功能的主要机构。因此，银行的盈利能力是衡量金融体系运行健康状况的重要指标。在此背景下，银行盈利能力与经济增长之间的关系对实体经济也具有重要意义。本研究旨在实证分析土耳其参与银行的盈利能力与各行业经济增长之间的因果关系。为此，研究人员使用了2005年第一季度至2024年第三季度的季度数据，通过傅里叶-户田-山本（Fourier-Toda-Yamamoto）因果检验方法，考察了参与银行的资产盈利能力、股本资本与GDP以及农业、工业、服务业和建筑业增长之间的关系。分析结果表明，土耳其参与银行的盈利能力与GDP及工业部门增长之间存在统计学上显著的双向因果关系；同时，股本盈利能力也与农业、工业和建筑业的增长存在显著的正相关关系。这一现象进一步表明，土耳其银行业提供的资金对工业部门具有积极影响，既体现在盈利能力的提升上，也体现在产业规模的扩张上。。

papers.title: Effects of fiscal policy on banking financial instability in West African Economic and Monetary Union
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「银行与信贷」领域，主题为：Effects of fiscal policy on banking financial instability in West African Economic and Monetary Union。涉及关键词：Economics。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: Medicaid Coverage for Obesity Medications: Utilization and Net-of-Rebate Spending -- by Coady Wing, Wei-Lun Lo, Maddie Potter, Tarik Yuce, Alberto Ortega, John Cawley, Thuy D. Nguyen, Kosali I. Simon
papers.abstract: We document state variation in Medicaid coverage for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications over time, and use a stacked difference-in-differences design to estimate the effects of coverage on utilization and net-of-rebate spending. Nine quarters out, coverage increases prescriptions for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by 0.82 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = 0.10). Coverage had no effect on GLP-1 prescribing for diabetes or cardiovascular indications, suggesting that off-label prescribing of diabetes formulations for obesity is not very common in the Medicaid program. The expansions do not appear to affect consumer spending at major online GLP-1 compounding firms, which suggests that the utilization response in our main analysis reflects new utilization rather than crowd-out. We find that coverage increases net-of-rebate Medicaid spending by $751.6 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = $92.0), compared to $986.9 in gross reimbursements—manufacturer rebates reduce the state’s net spending by approximately 24 percent. Across the 17 states that ever covered obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by mid 2025, coverage increased Medicaid net spending by around $2.68 billion per year. Extending Medicaid coverage in the remaining states would generate a further $3.63 billion in annual net spending.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们记录了各州在针对肥胖症的GLP-1药物医保覆盖范围方面的变化情况，并采用堆叠差异分析法（stacked difference-in-differences design）来评估医保覆盖对药物使用情况以及患者实际支出（扣除回扣后的金额）的影响。研究发现，在九个季度内，医保覆盖范围的扩大使得针对肥胖症的GLP-1药物处方数量每100名参保者每月增加了0.82份（标准误为0.10份）。医保覆盖对用于治疗糖尿病或心血管疾病的GLP-1药物的处方数量没有显著影响，这表明在Medicaid项目中，将GLP-1药物用于非适应症治疗的情况并不常见。此外，医保覆盖范围的扩大并未对主要在线GLP-1药物销售公司的消费者支出产生显著影响，这表明我们分析中的用药量增加主要反映了新患者的用药需求，而非现有患者的用药需求被挤出。医保覆盖范围的扩大使得患者实际支出（扣除回扣后）每100名参保者每月增加了751.6美元（标准误为92.0美元）；而如果按药品总报销金额计算，这一增幅为986.9美元。由于制造商提供的回扣，各州的净支出减少了约24%。截至2025年中期，已有17个州开始为针对肥胖症的GLP-1药...。研究方法：双重差分。

papers.title: Reserve Demand Estimation with Minimal Theory -- by Ricardo Lagos, Gastón Navarro
papers.abstract: We propose a new reserve-demand estimation strategy---a middle ground between atheoretical reduced-form econometric approaches and fully structural quantitative-theoretic approaches. The strategy consists of an econometric specification that satisfies core restrictions implied by theory and controls for changes in administered-rate spreads that induce rotations and shifts in reserve demand. The resulting approach is as user-friendly as existing reduced-form econometric methods but improves upon them by incorporating a minimal set of theoretical restrictions that any reserve demand must satisfy. We apply this approach to U.S. data and obtain reserve-demand estimates that are broadly consistent with the structural estimates.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了一种新的储备需求估算策略——这种策略介于无理论的简化形式计量经济学方法与完全结构化的定量理论方法之间。该策略采用了一种符合理论核心要求的计量经济学模型，并考虑了管理利率利差的变化对储备需求产生的影响（这些变化会导致储备需求的变动）。与现有的简化形式计量经济学方法相比，新方法在用户友好性方面毫不逊色，同时通过纳入任何储备需求都必须满足的最基本理论约束，对其进行了改进。我们将这一方法应用于美国的数据，得到的储备需求估算结果与基于结构模型的估算结果基本一致。。

papers.title: Granger Causality in Expectiles: an M-vine copula test
papers.abstract: A model-free measure of Granger causality in expectiles is proposed, generalizing the traditional mean-based measure to arbitrary positions of the conditional distribution. Expectiles are the only law-invariant risk measures that are both coherent and elicitable, making them particularly well-suited for studying distributional Granger causality where risk quantification and forecast evaluation are both relevant. Based on this measure, a test is developed using M-vine copula models that accounts for multivariate Granger causality with $d+1$ series under non-linear and non-Gaussian dependence, without imposing parametric assumptions on the joint distribution. Strong consistency of the test statistic is established under some regularity conditions. In finite samples, simulations show accurate size control and power increasing with sample size. A key advantage is the joint testing capability: causal relationships invisible to pairwise tests can be detected, as demonstrated both theoretically and empirically. Two applications to international stock market indices at the global and Asian regional level illustrate the practical relevance of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了一种无需模型的Granger因果关系度量方法，该方法将传统的基于均值的度量方法推广到条件分布的任意位置。期望值（expectiles）是唯一既满足法则不变性（law-invariance），又具备一致性（coherence）和可估计性（elicitability）的风险度量工具，因此特别适合用于研究分布层面的Granger因果关系——在这些情况下，风险量化与预测评估都具有重要意义。基于该度量方法，本文构建了一种基于M-vinecopula模型的检验方法，该方法能够处理具有$d+1$个序列的多元Granger因果关系，并且适用于非线性、非高斯依赖情形，同时不对联合分布做出参数化假设。在满足某些常规性条件的情况下，该检验统计量的强一致性得到了证明。在有限样本情况下，模拟结果表明该方法具有准确的统计功效控制能力，并且随着样本量的增加检验功效也会提升。该方法的一个关键优势在于其联合检验能力：理论上和实证上都表明，那些无法通过成对检验发现的因果关系可以通过该方法被识别出来。通过对全球及亚洲地区国际股票市场指数的两个应用案例，进一步展示了所提出框架的实际应用价值。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Unlocking AI's Potential in Agriculture: The Critical Role of Data
papers.abstract: India generates substantial volumes of public agricultural data, yet artificial intelligence (AI) adoption in farming remains limited and largely confined to pilot initiatives. This paper examines this gap by assessing India's agricultural data infrastructure against the requirements of AI systems deployed at scale. Drawing on a systematic review of major national datasets and digital initiatives including Soil Health Cards, crop insurance, AgriStack, and selected state platforms we identify persistent structural constraints, including temporal misalignment between data collection and agricultural decision cycles, spatial fragmentation arising from the absence of common geocodes linking soil, weather, and yield information, limited machine readability due to reliance on static data formats, and unclear governance frameworks that restrict data access and reuse. These deficiencies impede cross-dataset integration and automated decision support, with disproportionate consequences for smallholders, who constitute 86~\% of India's farmers and lack the capacity to compensate for weak data infrastructure. Drawing on implementation evidence from India and comparative international experiences, the paper identifies recurring features associated with scalable digital agriculture systems, including incentives linked to data provision, service bundling through local institutions, and sensor-enabled risk management.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】印度产生了大量的公共农业数据，然而人工智能（AI）在农业领域的应用仍然有限，主要局限于试点项目。本文通过评估印度的农业数据基础设施是否满足大规模部署的AI系统的需求，来探讨这一差距。通过对主要国家级数据集和数字化项目的系统分析（包括土壤健康卡、农作物保险、AgriStack以及部分州级平台），我们发现了持续存在的结构性问题：数据收集与农业决策周期之间的时间错位；由于缺乏统一的地理编码，导致土壤、天气和产量信息之间的空间关联性缺失；由于依赖静态数据格式，数据的可机器读取性有限；以及不明确的治理框架限制了数据的访问和再利用。这些缺陷阻碍了数据集之间的整合和自动化决策支持，对小农户造成了尤为严重的影响——小农户占印度农民总数的86%左右，且他们缺乏能力来弥补薄弱的数据基础设施所带来的问题。基于印度的实施案例和国际比较经验，本文总结了可扩展的数字农业系统所具备的共性特征，包括与数据提供相关的激励机制、通过地方机构提供的服务捆绑方案，以及基于传感器的风险管理手段。。

papers.title: Stable Matchings with Choice Correspondences Under Acyclicity
papers.abstract: We study the existence of stable matchings when agents have choice correspondences instead of preference relations. We extend the framework of Chambers and Yenmez (2017) by weakening the Path Independence assumption. For many-to-many markets, we show that stable matchings exist when choice correspondences satisfy Substitutability and a new General Acyclicity condition. We provide a constructive proof using a Grow or Discard Algorithm that iteratively expands or eliminates contracts until a strongly maximal Individually Rational set is reached. We provide an algorithm to obtain stable matchings in which rejected contracts are not permanently discarded, distinguishing our approach significantly from standard DAA-type algorithms. For one-to-one markets, we show that Path Independence alone does not guarantee stability. We introduce a replacement-based notion of stability and provide an algorithm that constructs stable matchings when choice correspondences satisfy Binary Acyclicity.   JEL classification: C62, C78, D01, D47   Keywords: choice correspondences, substitutability, general acyclicity, many-to-many matching, matching with contracts, Grow or Discard algorithm, replacement stability, binary acyclicity.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】。论文标题：Stable Matchings with Choice Correspondences Under Acyclicity。摘要概述：该研究围绕「Economics、Finance」相关议题展开，属于金融经济学方向的研究。。结论要点：已基于原文英文摘要提炼主题信息，建议结合原文获取精确结论与量化结果。。

papers.title: Heart Failure's First Shock and Nurse-Led Chronic Care
papers.abstract: We study how a first heart-failure hospitalization, an adverse health shock, changes patients' care, and whether a nurse-led chronic-care program sustains those post-shock investments. Using linked population-wide administrative records from Italy's Romagna Local Health Authority (2017-2023), we anchor event time at each patient's first CHF admission and exploit staggered timing to estimate dynamic effects. The shock triggers a sharp post-discharge surge: beta-blocker adherence, cardiology follow-up, and echocardiography rise immediately, while emergency-room use spikes just before admission and then stabilizes. We then estimate the incremental impact of enrollment in the Nurse-led Program for Chronic Patients (NPCP) using the interaction-weighted event-study estimator for staggered adoption. Under conventional difference-in-differences inference, NPCP strengthens long-run preventive engagement, with little detectable change in emergency-room use. HonestDiD sensitivity analysis indicates these gains are economically meaningful but not statistically definitive under modest departures from parallel trends.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了首次因心力衰竭住院这一负面健康事件如何改变患者的护理方式，以及由护士主导的慢性病管理计划是否能够维持这些护理措施的效果。利用意大利罗马涅地区卫生局（2017-2023年）提供的关联人口行政数据，我们将每个患者的首次心力衰竭住院时间作为事件基准点，并利用时间错开的特征来评估这些变化的动态效应。该事件引发了出院后的显著变化：患者对β受体阻滞剂的依从性、心脏病随访以及超声心动图检查的频率立即增加；而急诊室的使用率在入院前短暂上升后趋于稳定。随后，我们采用交互加权事件研究方法，评估了患者参加“护士主导的慢性病患者管理计划”（NPCP）所带来的额外影响。根据传统的差异-差异（Difference-in-Differences, DID）推断方法，该计划显著提升了患者的长期预防性护理参与度，同时对急诊室使用率的影响几乎可以忽略不计。通过HonestDiD敏感性分析发现，尽管在某些假设条件下存在轻微偏离平行趋势的情况，这些改善在经济学上仍具有意义，但在统计学上并不具有决定性。。研究方法：双重差分。

papers.title: Sovereign risk mitigation mechanism in emerging markets
papers.abstract: This paper explores a mechanism for mitigating sovereign risk in emerging markets without risks mutualization. The mechanism involves pooling diversified portfolios of sovereign bonds and issuing them in tranches, with the senior tranche offering low-risk payoffs protected by the subordination of the junior tranches. We argue that this mechanism is feasible for emerging markets. The senior bonds issued by the securitization vehicle attain the properties of a safe asset. The risk level of the junior bonds depends on the structure of the underlying sovereign bonds portfolio. Nevertheless, the properties of the synthetic bonds are, arguably, acceptable for the practical application of the proposed mechanism in promoting the development of financial markets in emerging markets and for practical tasks such as intergovernmental aid or lending.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文探讨了一种在不对主权风险进行共担的情况下缓解新兴市场主权风险的机制。该机制包括将多样化的主权债券组合汇集起来，并分批次发行这些债券，其中优先级较高的批次提供低风险回报，这种回报是通过次级批次债券的从属地位来保障的。我们认为这种机制在新兴市场中是可行的。通过证券化工具发行的优先级债券具备了安全资产的特性。次级债券的风险水平取决于基础主权债券组合的结构。尽管如此，这种合成债券的特性对于促进新兴市场金融市场的发展以及用于政府间援助或贷款等实际任务来说，可以说是可以接受的。。

papers.title: The Effect of Women's Employment on the Profitability Level of Participation Banks
papers.venue: International Journal of Islamic Economics and Finance Studies
papers.abstract: The International Money Fund (IMF) reported that although women earn 63% less than men, they spend three times more. Based on this striking statistical information, this research aimed to analyze the effects of women's employment in the society on the return on equity (ROE) and return on assets (ROA) of participation banks. The effects of women's employment values on Türkiye's participation bank ROA and ROE values between December 2005 and November 2023 were analyzed with a logit model. ROA was significantly and negatively correlated with female labor participation (r=-0.165), female employment (r=-0.166) and female unemployment (r=-0.333). Correlation coefficients showed that female unemployment rate was the most correlated factor with ROA. ROE was significantly and negatively correlated with female unemployment (r=-0.151). Effect of female labor force participation (B=0,009), female employment (r=-0,010) and female unemployment (r=-0,004) on ROA were statistically significant at multivariable level. However, effect of female unemployment on ROE was statistically insignificant (p>0.05). Results showed that female employment had significant effect on profitability of participation banks in Türkiye. Giving more emphasis to these issues and role of employed female in marketing strategies man make positive contributions to the short and long-term activities of banks.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】国际货币基金组织（IMF）报告指出，尽管女性的收入仅为男性的63%，但她们的支出却是男性的三倍。基于这一显著的统计数据，本研究旨在分析女性就业对社会中参与银行股本回报率（ROE）和资产回报率（ROA）的影响。研究使用逻辑回归模型（logit model）分析了2005年12月至2023年11月期间女性就业对土耳其参与银行ROA和ROE的影响。结果显示，女性劳动力参与度（r=-0.165）、女性就业率（r=-0.166）以及女性失业率（r=-0.333）与ROA之间存在显著负相关关系，其中女性失业率与ROA的相关性最强。女性劳动力参与度（B=0.009）、女性就业率（r=-0.010）以及女性失业率（r=-0.004）对ROA的影响在多变量层面具有统计学意义；然而，女性失业率对ROA的影响在统计上并不显著（p>0.05）。研究结果表明，女性就业对土耳其参与银行的盈利能力具有显著影响。通过更加重视这些问题以及女性员工在营销策略中的作用，管理层可以为银行的短期和长期发展做出积极贡献。。
